WITH group_counts AS (
    SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM Examination
    WHERE ID IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
), shares AS (
    SELECT record_count * 1.0 / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM group_counts
), benchmark AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
    FROM shares
), kept AS (
    SELECT gc.record_count, s.share, b.average_share
    FROM group_counts AS gc
    JOIN shares AS s ON s.share = gc.record_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(record_count) FROM group_counts)
    CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
    WHERE s.share > b.average_share
)
SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM kept

assumptions.assumption: Shares are computed from the total number of Examination records across nonmissing-ID groups, as specified; arithmetic remains unrounded.
